items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25

ctx.x: Every time his son sees me, his son, they're boiling, they drink, they see me, he started telling people about me and they started crying. About my dad. Every time I see him, it's a damn thing with my dad. And when we got most of the camp street, after we crossed Magazine, after Magazine is camp, he said, come on, let's play a number now. And the band started off, that man went way up above the steps, like Lou's what I said. And I said, I ain't never heard him blow like that before. And as soon as we got most of…
Where is that tomb exactly? I like to see it.
